subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades intentionally park legacy ownerless or delivery-unconfirmed outbox rows for manual recovery as part of the version 4 to version 8 database migration?
rationale: That fail-closed migration is safer than replaying a message through the wrong agent, but it deliberately changes an existing user's queued-message recovery behavior and therefore needs explicit ownership acceptance.

options.title: Approve guarded migration
options.body: Land after exact-head Android gates and an upgrade-from-release proof confirm ambiguous rows remain visible, non-retriable, and deletable without affecting correctly owned rows.

options.title: Preserve only provable rows
options.body: Revise the migration to retain automatic retry solely for legacy rows whose original agent owner can be derived without guessing.

options.title: Narrow the landing
options.body: Split the immediate composer-media fix from the broader cache and outbox migration until the permanent upgrade contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded migration
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head Android gates and an upgrade-from-release proof confirm ambiguous rows remain visible, non-retriable, and deletable without affecting correctly owned rows.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the migration and cross-surface ownership expansion and are the strongest available owner for accepting its upgrade semantics.
